record_title: A counterexample to the max-slope nonlinear-degradation GAS conjecture
provenance: Analytical counterexample within the standing monotonicity and regularity assumptions of the cited scalar delay equation; the interval bounds and local instability threshold are derived explicitly in RESULT.md.
limitations: Refutes the literal nonlinear extension of Theorem 3.6 obtained by substituting max_[m,M] h' for the linear degradation constant. It does not rule out other nonlinear sufficient conditions, provide a sharp replacement GAS criterion, or classify general nonlinear degradation laws.
